intro.title: Apex RS
intro.subtitle: A street-legal track weapon, engineered to dominate.
intro.lead: Born on the limit and built for the road, the Apex RS fuses motorsport-grade compounds with everyday composure — so the drive to the circuit hits as hard as the laps.

benefits.html: Engineered for track dominance and street performance alike
Addictive levels of steering response and mid-corner handling
Unrivaled grip derived from a motorsports-proven tread

statement.html: …who live life on the edge. The Apex RS takes track dominance straight to the street.

features.title: Every Rib Has a Job
features.intro: A purpose-built tread architecture that turns input into instant, repeatable grip — corner after corner.

items.title: Extra-Wide Shoulder Ribs
items.body: Maximize the contact patch under load to hold the line through high-speed cornering.

items.title: Featherlight Construction
items.body: A lightweight casing trims rotating mass for peak responsiveness and quicker turn-in.

items.title: Motorsport-Derived Compound
items.body: A track-bred rubber formulation that reaches grip temperature fast and stays consistent.

items.title: Optimized Center Rib
items.body: A continuous center band stabilizes the tire under hard braking for shorter, surer stops.

items.title: RS-DNA Technology
items.body: Decades of racing know-how distilled into a tread pattern tuned for the absolute limit.

items.title: Precision Sidewall
items.body: A stiff, reinforced sidewall delivers crisp, communicative feedback at the wheel.

cards.title: PitStop DNA
cards.body: Pushing boundaries and defying limits. PitStop was forged from a legacy of relentless performance. Ignite your passion, empower your pride, and drive your success as you conquer life on and off the track.

cards.title: Total Dominance Plan
cards.body: Experience unmatched performance with the Total Dominance Plan — high-performance tires that set a new standard in grip, handling, and durability. Engineered with cutting-edge technology and backed by independent testing, the Apex RS delivers on every drive.

availability.title: Sizes at Launch
availability.body: Over 40 sizes set to release, accommodating the most popular fitments for ultra-high-performance applications — from compact track toys to wide-body monsters.
availability.legal: Apex RS is USDOT street legal only
